scope: exploratory training-source grouped CV, previously studied folds
feature_selection: fit-only absolute base-weighted Pearson correlation with risk label; feature variance <= float64 epsilon gives zero association; descending magnitude, ascending head index ties
subset_seed: ensemble_seed + fold; sequential choice without replacement from sorted full-fit group IDs, sorted selected groups
weighting: original group/condition/item weights; member-only class factors; total loss mass anchored to original full-fit K1 token count
ensemble_combination: equal mean probabilities; calibrate one threshold on the mean, no member threshold tuning
threshold: calibration F1, then precision, then higher threshold; same as Round14
